name: Exam Week
desc:
💰USE CODE "release" (accessible in settings menu) to gain an XP boost and some extra cash! 
 ✨Double XP Event!

Your school's finals are coming up, and you didn't study again. Steal pages of exam answers and escape as quickly as you can...there just might be someone waiting for you.

A solo and multiplayer based horror game with an immersive environment. Buy new gear at the shop to give you an edge, customize your character with a unique look, and engage in tense gameplay.

⚠️ Warning: This experience contains  jumpscares, flashing lights, and loud noises.
🎧 Headphones recommended for the best experience.
